state:
Goal `core-math-2-3`: `Core\Math::exp`, `Core\Math::fdiv` and `Core\Math::floor` carry every feature proof — `about.md`, three examples, an attack, a bench and a `covers:` Rust test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs`'s test module — and their reference cards are rewritten in the plain voice.
Ten members of the goal's `--only` list still owe proofs: `format`, `fromBase`, `gcd`, `hypot`, `intDiv`, `isFinite`, `isNan`, `lcm`, `log`, `max`.
No proof found a bug in these three.
